_comment: VeinNet PersonalDelta contract, verified against the authoritative Gate 7 research repository during Hardware_integration_ready bundle creation (2026-09-01). Supersedes the source repo's config/inference_manifest.json H0.5 UNVERIFIED_UNSOURCED finding, which resulted from inspecting only the hardware repo and the nested public models/veinnet comparison repo, not the full model research workspace.
verification_method: Direct SHA-256 computation of the .onnx file, direct inspection of the ONNX export parity report, and direct reading of the exporter source that produced the artifact.

authoritative_source.repository: Veinnet_ResNet-34_and_MIMIC-|||_Project/gate7_max30102_personaldelta (research workspace, sibling of this repo, not part of veinnovate-hardware-core)
authoritative_source._note: This bundle (Hardware_integration_ready) does not and must not contain the ONNX file itself. It is supplied at runtime by the sibling VeinNet_integration_ready component; see sibling_paths.example.json.

model.name: VeinNet PersonalDelta (3-head ensemble, shared frozen encoder; seeds 42/43/44)
model.onnx_opset_source: Computed directly from the ONNX graph's opset_import during verification, and cross-confirmed against ONNX_EXPORT_PARITY_REPORT.json ('opset': 17).
model.expected_sha256_source: Computed directly via `shasum -a 256` against results/personaldelta_ensemble_42_43_44.onnx during verification; matches ONNX_EXPORT_PARITY_REPORT.json 'onnx_sha256' and FINAL_ARTIFACT_BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json item sha256 exactly.

io_contract.input_order_source: export_onnx.py export_and_check(): input_names = ["ppg", "morphology", "baseline_ppg", "baseline_morphology", "demographics", "baseline_cuff", "elapsed_segments"]. Shapes cross-confirmed against ONNX_EXPORT_PARITY_REPORT.json input_shapes (batch dim 8 in the parity run; batch is dynamic per dynamic_axes).
io_contract.demographics_order_source: gate7_max30102_personaldelta/demographics.py FEATURE_NAMES, verified identical to the integration spec's asserted order.

output.name: personal_bp
output.semantics_source: export_onnx.py PersonalDeltaExportEnsemble.forward(): 'mean_delta = torch.stack(deltas, dim=0).mean(dim=0); return baseline_cuff + mean_delta'. The addition happens INSIDE the exported graph — output_names=["personal_bp"] is the absolute SBP/DBP tensor, not a delta requiring further host-side addition. Cross-confirmed by ONNX_EXPORT_PARITY_REPORT.json sample outputs (~102/52 mmHg range, consistent with absolute BP, not a near-zero delta).

preprocessing_and_features._status: Owned by the sibling VeinNet_integration_ready component, not this hardware-edge bundle. This bundle performs no filtering/resampling/normalization on samples destined for the model (spec S1/S3) — protocol/window/SQI code here operates on raw RED/IR only.
preprocessing_and_features.preprocessing_normalization: band-pass 0.5-8Hz, robust MAD normalization, reshape to [3,1000] per the integration spec; exact implementation lives in VeinNet_integration_ready.
preprocessing_and_features.morphology_feature_definitions: 13-feature vector; exact definitions and normalization stats live in VeinNet_integration_ready, not sourced in this manifest.

versions._note: Active production values are read by VeinNetSiblingAdapter from the sibling runtime's frozen preprocessing and morphology contracts.

runtime_verification_requirements._comment: Enforced authoritatively by the installed sibling veinnet_runtime package at every production startup. receiver/veinnet_sibling_adapter.py calls VeinNetRuntime.load(), which verifies the real artifact hash and loaded ONNX I/O contract before BLE starts. receiver/model_runtime.py contains protocols/data containers only.
runtime_verification_requirements.sha256_check: mandatory, exact match required, fail closed
runtime_verification_requirements.opset_check: mandatory, exact match (17) required, fail closed
runtime_verification_requirements.input_names_and_order_check: mandatory, exact match required, fail closed
runtime_verification_requirements.output_name_check: mandatory, exact match ('personal_bp') required, fail closed
runtime_verification_requirements.on_any_mismatch: raise ModelRuntimeUnavailable; production inference must not proceed; no mock/fallback model may be substituted silently

superseded_contract._note: Recorded for traceability only. Do not use.
superseded_contract.calibration_field: reference_bp (B,2), passed directly into the head rather than as a delta anchor
superseded_contract.inference_mode: direct PyTorch (not ONNX) OR opset-16 ONNX via the blocked flash_exporter.py
